name: loops, skipped gates and a QA reopen — the paths a happy run never reaches
why: A happy-path walk proves only that the spine connects. This fixture drives the parts that actually broke in real runs: a red suite into DEBUG and back, a Gate A dispatch that died counted separately from a findings re-run, three ledgered skips that must never read as passes, edge 18 vs 18c, and a QA BLOCK that reopens with an is_fix milestone.
